storage_hygiene_2026-10-18-gecko.root_cause: 5 rows in features+backlog_items had `updated_at` stored as SQLite TEXT form 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' instead of RFC3339. row_to_feature (features.rs:36-87) and row_to_backlog_item (backlog.rs:71) call .parse::<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>() which fails, wrapped as FromSqlConversionFailure(7|10, Type::Text). The 'premature end of input' wording is rusqlite's framing of the chrono parse error.
fix_applied: UPDATE features SET updated_at = created_at WHERE id = 1 AND updated_at NOT GLOB '*T*';
UPDATE backlog_items SET updated_at = created_at WHERE updated_at NOT LIKE '%T%' OR length(updated_at) < 19;
